THE BEARD AND BLADE — THIRD-PARTY SOUND CREDITS

Inventory Sound Effects — artisticdude (submitted by Ogrebane)
https://opengameart.org/content/inventory-sound-effects
License chosen: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Used: leather_inventory.wav, cloth-inventory.wav, turn_page.wav.
Adaptations: mono conversion, silence trimming, DC removal, fades, gain normalization.

15 monster grunt/pain/death sounds — Michel Baradari
https://opengameart.org/content/15-monster-gruntpaindeath-sounds
License: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Used: grunt1/2; deathb/d/e/r/s; painb/d/e/s.
Adaptations: mono conversion, silence trimming, DC removal, fades, gain normalization;
minor playback pitch variation. No endorsement by the original creators is implied.

The following are licensed Creative Commons Zero 1.0:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

RPG Sound Pack — artisticdude
https://opengameart.org/content/rpg-sound-pack
Used for doors/chests, UI, rolls, throwing, magic/teleport and impacts.

Different steps on wood, stone, leaves, gravel and mud — TinyWorlds
https://opengameart.org/content/different-steps-on-wood-stone-leaves-gravel-and-mud
Used: stone01.ogg; softened, normalized and converted to PCM.

5 break, crunch impacts — Independent.nu (submitted by qubodup)
https://opengameart.org/content/5-break-crunch-impacts
Used: impactcrunch01–05; trimmed, normalized and converted to PCM.

Explosions — EZduzziteh
https://opengameart.org/content/explosions-4
Used: explosion1_0.ogg; trimmed/faded shorter edits for explosion, tea and flashbang.

Fantozzi's Footsteps — Fantozzi (single-step edits submitted by qubodup)
https://opengameart.org/content/fantozzis-footsteps-grasssand-stone
Used: Stone L1–L3 and R1–R3; softened and normalized.

Swishes Sound Pack — artisticdude
https://opengameart.org/content/swishes-sound-pack
Used: swish 5/7/8/9, trimmed and normalized for weapon swings.

Fantasy Weapons and Apparel SFX Library — Vehicle / Jan Schupke
https://opengameart.org/content/fantasy-weapons-and-apparel-sfx-library
Used: seax-unsheathe 01/03, trimmed and normalized for equipment swaps.

Exact source-to-game filenames are recorded in AudioSource/Foley/manifest.json
in the source repository. These licenses apply to the listed audio contributions,
not the game's original code or artwork.

The Free Firearm Sound Library — Ben Jaszczak, Brian Nelson, Kevin Heras,
and Matthew Nanney. CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
https://opengameart.org/content/the-free-firearm-sound-library
Used AR-15 D_32P/D_24P and AK-47 C_28P single-shot recordings.
Modified: trimmed tails, mono conversion, level normalization and fades.

Voices Sound Effects Library — Little Robot Sound Factory
https://www.littlerobotsoundfactory.com
https://opengameart.org/content/voices-sound-effects-library
CC-BY 3.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Used Human_Good_00–02, Human_Evil_01–02, Human_DyingBreath_00–02,
Robot2_00–03. Modified: trimmed, normalized, mono, fades, slight runtime pitch.
No endorsement by the original creator is implied.

Engine/Mechanic working sound — jwiese
https://opengameart.org/content/enginemechanic-working-sound
CC0 option selected: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Used loop.flac, shortened, faded and normalized for Scout Drone flight.

RPG Ambience - Dungeon — HitCtrl
https://opengameart.org/content/rpg-ambience-dungeon
CC-BY 3.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Used for looping gameplay music. Modified: PCM16 conversion and peak attenuation;
original loop boundaries preserved, low runtime mix gain. No endorsement implied.

Female Hurt Grunts & Groans — AuraVoice / Nocturnal_Vanguard
https://opengameart.org/content/female-hurt-grunts-groans
CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Used for Rime Empress nonfatal hurt reactions only.
Modified: three excerpts, mono PCM16, trimmed, faded and level-matched; no pitch shift.

Female Warrior Cheer — SkyRae
https://opengameart.org/content/female-warrior-cheer
CC0 option selected: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Used for Rime Empress's opening attack yell, replacing the previous attack grunts.
The spoken "ALRIGHT" and "YES" excerpts are excluded from playback.
Modified: one excerpt, mono PCM16, trimmed, faded and level-matched; no pitch shift.

Dragon — Breviceps
https://freesound.org/people/Breviceps/sounds/466830/
CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Used for Iron Matriarch intro and gameplay vocals.
Source: supplied high-quality MP3; original WAV unavailable.
Modified: excerpts, level adjustment, short fades and PCM conversion; no pitch shift.
